subject: Implementation agreement, roadmap & decision log - AstraHealth
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@astrahealth.com>
To: elliot_price@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-04T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps - implementation coordination

Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Astra is excited about Redwood. Procurement asked I capture an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a short decision log so they can start internal approvals. Can you share a single-sheet timeline with milestones, owners, and target dates (high level is fine) plus any outstanding decisions that need sign-off?

Key constraints on our side: consolidated vendor approval by 8/15, security questionnaire turnaround by 8/11, and go-live target is 10/01.

If you can send a draft MAP and confirm who from Redwood will own the onboarding, I can sync my IT and procurement leads.

Thanks,
Susan
Product Operations Manager
AstraHealth

Attachments: none
From: elliot_price@redwood.com <elliot_price@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@astrahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-04T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps - implementation coordination

Hi Susan — great meeting yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Astra-MAP-v1.1.xlsx) and a one-page implementation agreement summary. High level items:

- Redwood onboarding owner: Marissa Cole (CS Lead) — will own kickoff and acceptance gates.
- Implementation lead (technical): Ben Carter — will run integration tasks, API keys, and test harness.
- Milestones (proposed):
  • 8/06 — Kickoff & discovery (stakeholders, SSO, network needs)
  • 8/11 — Security questionnaire complete / evidence uploaded
  • 8/15 — Procurement sign-off / SOW signature
  • 9/05 — Integration complete + smoke tests
  • 9/18 — Pre-production validation window begins
  • 10/01 — Target go-live (rolling traffic)

Outstanding decisions for Astra:
- SSO method (SAML vs OIDC) — ASSET: Susan / IT team to confirm by 8/06
- Data retention window for logs — default 90 days unless compliance requests change it; procurement to confirm by 8/11

I've also attached the procurement questionnaire we typically provide. Please review and let us know gaps. I'm happy to jump on a 30-min call with your procurement and IT on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Elliot Price
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ellliot_price@redwood.com
Attachments: Astra-MAP-v1.1.xlsx, procurement-questionnaire.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@astrahealth.com>, elliot_price@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation agreement, roadmap & decision log - AstraHealth

Hi Susan — copying my proposed kickoff agenda and RACI summary below so we can lock attendees for the 8/06 session. I will be the CS owner through production acceptance.\n
Proposed 8/06 Kickoff (30–45 min):
- Introductions + success criteria (5 min)
- Network & infra checklist (Ben) (10 min)
- SSO approach & next steps (Elliot + Astra IT) (10 min)
- Security questionnaire walk-through & evidence list (Marissa) (10 min)
- Next steps / owners / dates (5 min)

RACI (high level):
- Kickoff & discovery: R: Marissa; A: Susan; C: Ben; I: Astra IT
- Security evidence upload: R: Astra IT; A: Procurement; C: Marissa; I: Elliot
- Integration testing: R: Ben; A: Marissa; C: Astra Devs; I: Procurement
- Go-live acceptance: R: Astra Ops; A: Marissa; C: Ben; I: Elliot

I'll prepare a short decision log and send an updated MAP after the kickoff. If procurement needs a redline to the SOW, loop legal; otherwise we can sign via DocuSign once they approve.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi all,

We reviewed the MAP spreadsheet and have two quick asks before we can route for internal procurement approval: 1) a concise SOW (one page) with billing cadence and cancellation terms, and 2) confirmation that logs are retained for 90 days by default with audit export available on request. Please send the SOW and we will circulate.

We also prefer DocuSign for signature. Can Redwood prepare the DocuSign envelope and add Procurement (procurement@astrahealth.com) and Legal (legal@astrahealth.com) as signers?

Procurement team
AstraHealth
